data.answer: A federal judge has ruled that a Texas-based oil firm can continue to pump oil through pipelines along the Santa Barbara County coast under an emergency order from the Trump administration, transferring much of the regulatory authority over the oil operation to federal officials, stripping the state of its oversight. Diversified Energy Company reported second-quarter 2026 results, including an estimate of cash proceeds for FY 2026 asset optimization of ~$135 million based on July 2026 strip prices. The company is expanding its value creation strategy through a disciplined one-rig operated development program focused on generating high-return organic cash flow growth from its high-quality, drill-ready inventory in Oklahoma.

The Company includes Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Free Cash Flow in the Company’s Full Year 2026 Outlook. Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted Free Cash Flow are non-GAAP financial measures and have not been reconciled to the most comparable GAAP financial measures because it is not possible to do so without unreasonable efforts due to [...] Operated Development Program: Building on our proven acquisition and asset optimization model, DEC is expanding its value creation strategy through a disciplined one-rig operated development program focused on generating high-return organic cash flow growth from our high-quality, drill-ready inventory in Oklahoma. [...] Expanded significant Oklahoma footprint: Estimated more than 450 economic drilling locations at $65/Bbl oil and $3.25/MMBtu natural gas pricing, representing over 20 years of development runway at a one-rig pace. This inventory provides strong visibility into future production, reserves, and cash flow generation.
